lines.zh: 暖流往北，我贴着礁壁走
lines.en: The warm current runs north, I hug the reef wall.

lines.zh: 深水里的光，只够照亮我的牙
lines.en: Down here light barely reaches my teeth.

lines.zh: 这条水道我一天巡三遍
lines.en: I patrol this channel three times a day.
My silver scales brush the sand, barely a sound.
Do not tail me, my tail is strong.

lines.zh: 温水区的水母，今天避开了
lines.en: The jellyfish in the warm water kept clear today.

lines.zh: 我从沉船的破口穿过去
lines.en: I slip through the gap in the sunken hull.

lines.zh: 影子在下面，那是我的路线
lines.en: The shadow below is my route.
After this reef I will sweep the deep trench.
I swim slow, I only strike fast.
The colder the water, the less I move.

lines.zh: 沙地上那道痕是我留的
lines.en: That groove in the sand is mine.
A shoal of small fish ahead, I follow it.

lines.zh: 礁石缝里挤，只有我过得去
lines.en: The crevice is tight, only I fit through.

lines.zh: 我游在礁石上方，谁也别挡路。
lines.en: I swim above the reef; no one gets in my way.

lines.zh: 我张口露了一排牙，鱼群就散。
lines.en: I bare a row of teeth and the school scatters.

lines.zh: 嘴里还留着昨夜的鳞味
lines.en: The taste of last night's scales stays in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这水温刚好，我不急着走
lines.en: This water is just right, I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 那条大鱼又在我的地盘转
lines.en: That big fish circles my ground again.
I whet my teeth on the reef stone.

lines.zh: 海面上有船影，我沉低一点
lines.en: A hull shadow crosses above, I sink lower.

lines.zh: 这层水色发绿，说明有藻
lines.en: The water turns green here, there is algae.
I count the schools that pass.

lines.zh: 深沟里安静得像没有水
lines.en: The trench is so still it feels waterless.
I do not school, I travel alone.

lines.zh: 暖流一停，我就知道要变天
lines.en: When the warm current stalls, weather is turning.

lines.zh: 有根断绳挂在礁上，碍眼
lines.en: A cut rope hangs on the reef, it bothers me.

lines.zh: 我身上的条纹比昨天淡
lines.en: My stripes look paler than yesterday.

lines.zh: 这片海我熟得闭眼也走
lines.en: I know this sea well enough to swim blind.
The sand stirs below, a crab.
You hang in the water with nothing under your feet.
I know that net, do not twitch it.
You watch me, I am measuring you too.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁和盐的味道
lines.en: You smell of iron and salt.
Do not put your hand in my channel.
You are bigger, but you swim clumsily.
I see the blade at your waist.

lines.zh: 你在礁顶停太久，会被浪掀
lines.en: You linger on the reef crest, the swell will tip you.
Your shadow arrives before you do.
Do not stare at my lateral line.
A corner of my tooth broke, you owe me.
My scales are pried up.
That hit landed on my gills, dull.
The blow numbs my lateral line.
The water tastes of salt, my own.
Who strikes from behind the reef?
I back into the crevice to breathe.
A piece of my tail fin is gone.
That force is not a fish's.
I have your scent now.
That silver flicker makes my head swim.
Bait or hook, I can tell.
You put small fish in the net.

lines.zh: 这点味道，值得靠近一步
lines.en: That scent is worth one step closer.
I bite not from hunger, but to be sure.

lines.zh: 手腕上的亮片，借我看看
lines.en: That shiny band on your wrist, let me look.

lines.zh: 饵在水里转，我就跟着转
lines.en: The bait spins, so I spin with it.
Loosen your grip and I back off.
This smells like a wounded fish.

lines.zh: 再靠近半尺，我就试一口
lines.en: Half a foot closer and I will test a bite.
You bumped into my flank.
The reef is hard, my scales harder.
Do not poke my back with that oar.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞偏了半丈
lines.en: That shove knocked me half a fathom off.
The net rope snagged my tail fin.
You stepped into my sandy hollow.
The water is muddied, I cannot see you.
Back three paces, you block my turn.

lines.zh: 沉船的木板被我撞响了
lines.en: I knocked the wreck's planks and they rang.

lines.zh: 别挤，这条缝只够一条鱼
lines.en: Do not crowd, this gap fits one fish.

lines.zh: 暖水季节到了，我该找伴
lines.en: Warm season is here, I should find a mate.

lines.zh: 她游得比我稳，鳞也更亮
lines.en: She swims steadier than me, her scales brighter.

lines.zh: 我们用尾巴拍水打招呼
lines.en: We greet each other with tail slaps.
Swimming side by side for a while settles it.

lines.zh: 这条深沟是我们共同的界线
lines.en: This trench is the border we share.

lines.zh: 我把最好的礁洞让给她
lines.en: I give her the best cave in the reef.
She nips me once, that is a yes.
Two shadows swim pressed together.
The spawning bed must be soft sand.

lines.zh: 网别落到我产卵的沙上
lines.en: Keep your net off my spawning sand.
I take this fish meat in my jaw.
What falls into the water is mine.
I have no hands, I carry with teeth.

lines.zh: 这枚亮片含在嘴里正合适
lines.en: This shiny scrap fits nicely in my mouth.
I spit the bone into the crevice.
Bread sunk to the bottom, I am not picky.
The thread you dropped, I carry it for fun.
Too heavy, I cannot hold it.

lines.zh: 这堆东西我先藏在沙下
lines.en: I bury this pile under the sand first.

lines.zh: 咬一口，尝尝是不是吃的
lines.en: One bite to learn if it is food.

lines.zh: 那条受伤的鱼，我盯上了
lines.en: That wounded fish, I have picked it.

lines.zh: 血丝散开的方向，就是目标
lines.en: The blood trail points me at my target.
It is alone, the moment is right.
I flatten low against the sand.
That crab moves too slowly.

lines.zh: 你的脚在踩水，破绽很大
lines.en: Your feet kick and give you away.
A shadow hides behind the reef.
First half a circle, then head on.
It has not noticed me yet.
This bite has to land true.
I circle you, waiting for your flank.
You step back, I advance a foot.
My teeth show on purpose.
Do not turn and flee, fish chase backs.
The more you thrash, the easier the bite.
I glide along your calf.

lines.zh: 你的网在水里张着，我绕着
lines.en: Your net hangs open, I circle around it.
I count your breaths, waiting for them to break.
One step closer and I charge.
Put down what you are holding.
My jaws clamp your wrist guard.
I ram your ribs, faster than biting.
The tip leaves a single red line.
You shake your arm, I hold on.

lines.zh: 这一口是警告，不是要命
lines.en: This bite is a warning, not a kill.
My tail sweeps and you fall back.
I strike upward from below.

lines.zh: 咬穿了你的网，不是你的手
lines.en: I tore your net, not your hand.
Blood in the water sharpens me.
Bite, then withdraw, no second pass.

lines.zh: 我从深水的暗处升上来
lines.en: I rise from the dark of the deep.
The warm current carried me to this reef.

lines.zh: 水压一变，我知道到浅处了
lines.en: The pressure changed, I am in shallows.
A flash of silver, and I am here.

lines.zh: 这片海面第一次见我的背鳍
lines.en: This surface sees my dorsal fin for the first time.

lines.zh: 我巡的新水道，从这开始
lines.en: My new channel starts here.

lines.zh: 沙还没落定，我已经绕了一圈
lines.en: The sand has not settled and I have circled once.
Do not cast yet, I just arrived.
A deep-water fish does not know the shallows.
I smell an unfamiliar bay.
The surface is on fire.
I got flung onto the sand.
I am in water and cannot breathe.
The blast flips me over.
An arrow sticks in my back.
Light burns along my scales.
Three days without a bite.
Lightning struck the water.
There is no water below.
